notes.title: land on planets in off course
notes.content:
Hello all.
Now my work is focused on creating planets for Hero. Flying ship is fun but landing and building base on planet should be more fun.
Existing planets in game are far away and only possibility to get closer was to go to orbit.

Next step will be......landing  from planet orbit  - probably by means of capsule.

Planet is grid tile based - some I am testing with huge radius 500 tiles. hero will collect resources
and also build.

check screenshots... 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45200660/b327c44826ae4c4ff7148b7f2de80ce451ee0b89.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45200660/c5e5f4cc8032cba8abcbcf907f71d8f83f9f8194.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45200660/56e207a76611177274137b2b16518a4e0c0f2884.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45200660/30d34a8beb4d30400ebabeb35e294854162308fd.png[/img]

Technical info if you interested:
view of planet is: top view. same as in space building ships.
I was considering sideview but decided against it would be easy to dig but it would not be consisted with existing space game.
planets are randomly generated - I am using noise heat map for that. grid is half what was in space 24 by 24 pixels.(testing this maybe i will go with 48x48 like in space) for now I am experimenting with 5 tiles types: grass, sand, water, rock, ice. more to come for sure. for now no chunk on planets. when i will hit performance issue i will implement chunks. (in space i already have them)
huge planets for now are very light and responsive - just tiles for now. later with animals and some functioning builds probably i will have to limit planet radius.
this is second iteration of planet generator, first was using autotile - was promising but planets took long time to generate, this one is very fast.
as a side affect i will try to use autotile for builds -i will try to make video on you tube to show that coming soon.


After I will settle with main planet generator, next will be planet vegetation and animals,
After that builds on planet for Hero to be creative - get resources and build.
Next enemy on planet.....maybe no. lets not go too far......


Still not working on in game tutorial. tutorial is going to be last item to work....when game will not change much from programming point of view. I know that connecting pipes is main hard task in game.
watch some videos on you tube and go to current in game tutorial.
tip: idea of pipe is to transport. start from tank which is full - connect to build which needs this element. (engines - needs oxidizer and fuel)

thank you all and happy building space ships.

notes.title: update 0.66
notes.content:
update to 0.66

main aspects in this update is CORE functionality.

-new builds
CORE - core build will fix damaged builds on ship.
core needs to be charged to get that functionality.
other corresponding builds: core chargers - place them around core and connect to enriched uranium
, core transfer build - allows to transfer core values to heros suite

SUITE SHELF cabinet. hero on ship can leave suite at shelf.

screenshots below:
-core visible with core chargers from nuclear reactor
-hero without suite on ship breathing ship oxygen successfully - suite in cabinet
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45200660/5faacbae7ade9812d33598ada31e25c0fb6db558.png[/img]

try new builds in sandbox mode.


suite have got overall functionality check/additions - suite has some properties like: temperature, core level, etc.  - which could be upgraded for better hero performance. also for now suite is providing hero with some  life supports, if suite is stored hero is depending on ship environment (heat, oxygen). if those will be bad than heros heatlh will deterioriate faster (his metabolism will be faster - faster breathing, more energy used for heat)

-hero suite configuration:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45200660/671577f2a5441b417c839bc8a68f305f30547c58.png[/img]
possible upgrades to various heros suite elements - upgrading actually will allow to use oxygen slower, hero speed will be faster, suite temp will stay at correct temp longer. To upgrade specific item in suite - those items needs to be researched first in TREE TECH like any other research
many aspects added to tech tree for suite items
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45200660/a3ebc8db9f9cd190eec178a44e2befeba91011c9.png[/img]


-connected with core idea is build damage - now showing status on builds itself. now if core is correctly functioning - core will fix damaged builds. below core fixing build:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45200660/dc000c835fb6362377c0534e700825534e777f66.png[/img]


- custom key bindings - set yours own keys for corresponding action, I already was trying implement keys action on keyboard for left and right handed, but now for most important actions you can set custom keys bindings by yourself - and those will be saved to config file.
Press button with mouse - and text will show on button - press key to bind........  
then press new key from keyboard for that action
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45200660/d08e3b8b8480c55bf4f72b1ba02cba4694c9ae44.png[/img]


This update will brake old games saves (but you will get warning about it). Many new aspects were added to save and load functions. 
main game and demo updated too.



thank you all

notes.title: main update game to 0.6
notes.content:
update game ver. 0.6 - plenty of new builds and new game tank system for fluids and gases.


ADDITIONS:
new game concept:
-any enclosed area could store elements. This allows you to create huge tank areas. one cell can store 300. Enclosed area needs to have floors. any builds could be used to enclose/create area but I designed special build for that purpose - matching tanks design shown below. builds 270,271,272 
To function you need to use valve in - to provide elements to enclosed area.
Optionally you can place valve out to take elements out and use in any production lines.
You can place many valve ins and many valve outs in the same huge tank.
Mixing different elements in one huge tank is not recommended (for now). One huge tank one type of element.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45200660/306163f9488a77259dadc13118c9c4fd734fd2e9.png[/img]
More complex huge tanks
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45200660/7c69c5105803c2d04d19855cd69d224f62d36fa9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45200660/6a2bc8ec72e1bf2aa547747d3c311ba61c632d49.png[/img]
technical info/boring if you interested:
huge tanks system was created with cell automata - this took long time to code and I did 3 iterations/variations of this system. With last I am happy with results. Propagate cell automata was easy task, draining it was more complex. Cells can be vented in space if hatch is open or any build close to cell is damaged/removed. Cells propagate fast with very small level of element, than they will disappear or grow bigger depend on situation around cell.
Now this system is perfect for use as  oxygen on ship for HERO. Old oxygen system was removed. To fill ship with oxygen for HERO use new build: oxygen valve generator. 
Thin layer (oxy for hero cell is 10 not 300) of oxygen  for Hero will be created on floor and  Hero will breath that oxygen every 3 seconds. Hero automatically detect when oxy is on floor.  Oxy valve generator will provide more oxy if needed from tank.

New oxy system for HERO. Info was fixed/recoded to get correct data.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45200660/8792a2cb825429402063eee6cbb03c7ebe0e0ccc.png[/img]
As a reminder Hero breathing on ship will create CO2, to mitigate set co2 scrubbers.
Next  will be some more builds for that cell automata  first to come to mind is volume counter - how much is in huge tank(present in this update - 263) more to come in future update.

NEW BUILDS:

-research computer build
This build will produce DATA BITS needed for research. Require Hero to be present by desk. Builds needs: electricity and one of noble gases, optionally computer node might be placed to for faster research (best node - every 5 seconds new data bits, worst - 30 seconds)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45200660/3ef23b222400b5a078494aa4b4a503473a8a4cea.png[/img]

-computer nodes - to speed up various computer task - for now used only in research computer

-air lock builds (250,251,252) - hatches for leaving/entering ship without depressurizing whole ship, only some minimal level of oxygen is taken to pressurize lock itself. ship oxygen stays on floor.
Those builds to function needs tank with oxygen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45200660/932e79f363d24c0ebbfea33126b736b710b32259.png[/img]


-old hatch doors build (111,143,155) - will leak/vent all air in ship if door is open. Than if oxygen  generator is present new oxygen will be placed on floor again.

- huge tank volume counter - counts level of  element is in huge tank
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45200660/37550858a9e28cea29f1c69d21695006ffe08113.png[/img]


NEW SKILLS
computer science branch skills - to use computer builds
construction 2 - to use Huge tanks builds


FIXES
-dock module - fixed some errors
-entry hatch - build 111,143,155 redid animations, cleanup sprites
-uran elements - not showing correctly for multiple - fixed in elements exception fix
-hero look at - look at when using gun, look at off when using arrows left right - fixed

FILE SYSTEM
- added file overwrite warning - if file exists already
implemented for saving game files and saving ship files
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45200660/7f8483e983003b7b36b19b869a5705704ddda5dd.png[/img]
- introducing save game versioning - loading saved file from older game versions - game was updated and old saves will cause game crash
warning will show up. This will be helpful in removing some old not compatible anymore game saves.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45200660/01020c3a4b82654882d95d38f176562d203b8510.png[/img]

summary:
plenty of additions in this update,
after updating game to this version old saves will not work, apologies for that - but at least you will have warning about it.
demo was update too to this 0.60 version
Thank you all spaceship builders.

notes.title: update new builds

game update
some bug fixes and additions



additions:
-new build elements scanner - will work if one of noble gases is connected by pipes.
In builds actions press:
[set element to scan] - to set element
[stop device] - to stop scanning

Selected element to scan will be shown in closest asteroid. Very useful device if you need some very specific element
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45200660/0c7b202029939b62e92d4e91a14fff631aa0726a.png[/img]

-new life support build. hibernation capsule
Builds actions are:
-[HIBERNATE HERO]
-[UNHIBERNATE]
Capsule will work if electricity and oxygen is connected by pipes. Minimal level (20) of those elements  is necessary in capsule - to allow for new hibernation.
Although if elements are depleted completely hero can be unhibrnated without any problems
Hero needs to go close/on hibernation capsule to activate build actions then press [Hibernate Hero]
Hero in hibernation will slowly replenish health and breathing and metabolism will be stopped.
Use when yours ship is strong and you plan long voyage. 
Build is integrated in aspects of game:
-destroying build or whole structure will unhibernate Hero automatically.(He will survive)
-load/save integration
-when Hero is hibernated you cannot select him. You need to unhibrnate first.

notes.title: introduction of game
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45200660/d93dd729d5e168a474dac8d7694736871eef2f96.png[/img]

Welcome.
Game is in early access. I was working on that project for about a year.
I am solo developer. 

I am very excited to announce that game in current state is fully playable.
Main aspects of game are:

- sandbox mode:
Build yours space ship with all builds unlocked (no need for research), no stress environment, build without enemies. Hero still will need collect resources and set all production lines.
Building space ship is main job of Hero in this mode, placing parts of ship is really not restrained to anything, you can design ship however you wont. Your structure doesn't even have to be a ship, maybe you design farming station or planet drill station or huge power plant. All resources are centrally available you can distribute them however you wont to those structures.
 Setting production lines is next step here, connecting certain build with specific resources. Managing flow of resources is done by PIPE system. There is also a huge freedom how you connect pipes, where you put them, how many bend points pipes system has.
Pipes will start from some build for example tank and will finish with snap in to for example engine. 
On ship certain systems can be placed: rockets, farming, life support, electricity, weapons, mixing new element, etc. It really depends what is needed if you wont to fly that structure then: rocket system is needed.
Bottom line there is huge freedom how you design, and how ship will look and what functionality it will have.
You can save your ship and load it in arcade mode. 

- arcade mode:
Main mode of game. Hero needs to manage plenty: fight enemy, collect resources, and build space ship.
After some initial enemy waves and getting some resources Hero should start building, find some place far from enemy activity and research new builds in TECH TREE and build space ship.
More than one structures is possible for Hero to have. So you can load/save ships. So create same habitat stations, farming structures or keep everything on one huge ship this is up to you.
Now enemy will come so some damage will be done. You need to defend yours structures so building weapons systems is important here. Every next wave of enemy is stronger, but so yours ship to can have better weapons, better hulls, defense systems. Unlock new better builds by research in TECH TREE.
Hero has plenty of weapon types to choose from (new addition I just made new lasers).
All weapons are using gun energy so better weapons are using more energy, there is one unlimited but with very weak damage. Enemy can have different properties: alpha - will search actively for Hero,
weak fighter - fast and weak, regular fighter, and main enemy ship - powerful, build from exactly the same builds what Hero can use. Hero can have fighters too. Just build garage connect kerosene fuel and you can create fighters too. Hero can get health adds up and ammo power from crash sites after destroying some enemy types. So arcade mode can be very fun too, Hero can respawn 5 times.


I like  both modes of game. 
Game is in Early Access so some changes are going to be made. 
Demo is available get it today to see for yourself what game is about and Wishlist full game.
Working on finished touches for main game to be released soon.


thank You
JG
